source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: Room for 6 models, and only LEAGUES OF VOTANN INFANTRY models may embark. ARTILLERY, EXOARMOUR, EXOFRAME and IRONKIN STEELJACKS models may not embark. As you begin Declare Battle Formations, you may pick one of your HEARTHKYN WARRIORS units that has not been divided before and separate it into two units as close to equal in size as possible, noting which models make up each. One of the two must begin the battle embarked in this model; the other may begin embarked in a different TRANSPORT or be set up on its own.

splitUnit.when: start of the Declare Battle Formations step

otherMay: be deployed as a separate unit
